verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch's GitHub README lists GraphQL and a full-duplex channel over a single TCP connection, which describes WebSocket support. Both mentions are brief feature blurbs without dedicated docs, and nothing in the pack covers gRPC or SSE. missing for 10: gRPC support, SSE support, first-party docs detailing GraphQL and WebSocket request workflows, hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a developer, I can send GraphQL, gRPC, WebSocket, and SSE requests, not just REST

citations.quote: GraphQL is a query language for APIs and a runtime for fulfilling those queries with your existing data.
